source_name: Reviewed demand planning scenario, arrival-process evidence, exercise design, or literature values
required_external_input: reviewed passenger-volume basis, arrival process or assembly window, simulation horizon, and KPI penalty rationale or explicit sensitivity-only treatment
required_reviewer_action: review demand scale, arrival process, time horizon, and censoring penalty rationale
acquisition_command: manual reviewed scenario, planning, or literature acquisition; do not infer demand from current simulation outputs
claim_boundary: Parameter source-readiness packet only; not source evidence, not accepted parameter calibration, not weak-parameter acceptance, not evidence-gate closure, and not publication-readiness approval.
notes: These parameters define the decision-support scenario and censoring KPI. They still require source review or explicit bounded-scenario acceptance before final claims.

source_name: Reviewed agency fleet roster, vehicle-capacity source, exercise fleet package, or transport-planning literature
required_external_input: reviewed vehicle capacities, feasible load factors, available fleet counts by role, or explicit scenario-fleet assumption
required_reviewer_action: review vehicle capacities and finite fleet counts as source-backed or scenario-bounded
acquisition_command: manual agency, exercise, or literature source acquisition; do not treat config fleet sizes as an operational inventory
claim_boundary: Parameter source-readiness packet only; not source evidence, not accepted parameter calibration, not weak-parameter acceptance, not evidence-gate closure, and not publication-readiness approval.
notes: The current values are scenario assumptions. A final study needs reviewed source-backed capacities/counts or explicit sensitivity boundaries.

source_name: Reviewed dispatch schedule, staging rule, depot/layover basis, or policy scenario rule
required_external_input: reviewed dispatch interval, turnaround or layover time, first departure anchor, or explicit policy-sensitivity treatment
required_reviewer_action: review dispatch interval and turnaround treatment as policy scenario assumptions
acquisition_command: manual operating-plan, exercise-design, or literature acquisition
review_or_derivation_command: review policy_alternatives.csv and fleet_assumptions.csv, then run .\.venv\Scripts\python scripts\write_parameter_review_packet.py
claim_boundary: Parameter source-readiness packet only; not source evidence, not accepted parameter calibration, not weak-parameter acceptance, not evidence-gate closure, and not publication-readiness approval.
notes: Dispatch and turnaround settings govern both bus-only and multimodal road legs. This worksheet does not approve a real deployment schedule.

required_external_input: reviewed transfer path length, walking speed, vertical-circulation or crowding assumptions, and per-passenger delay treatment
blocking_reason: no station-layout, observed transfer, or pedestrian-flow source artifact is present
required_reviewer_action: supply transfer path, walking/crowding, field-observation, or literature evidence
acquisition_command: manual station-layout, field-observation, or literature acquisition

claim_boundary: Parameter source-readiness packet only; not source evidence, not accepted parameter calibration, not weak-parameter acceptance, not evidence-gate closure, and not publication-readiness approval.
notes: The baseline fixed transfer delay and disabled crowding delay remain assumptions until reviewed transfer evidence or sensitivity bounds are recorded.
